knowledge_point.title: Filling a Table of Values for a Parametric Curve

question.:question/problem:
Consider the curve with parametric equations

$$
x=5 t + 3,\,y=3 t - 2,\,-1\le t\le 4.
$$

Fill in the blanks in the following table of values:

| **$t$** | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $a$ | $3$ | $8$ | $13$ | $b$ | $23$ |
| $y$ | $-5$ | $-2$ | $c$ | $4$ | $7$ | $10$ |

Find the value of $a-b-c.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
- To find the value of $a,$ we substitute $t=-1$ into $x=5 t + 3.$ This gives

$$
a=5 (-1) + 3=(3)+(-5)=-2.
$$

- To find the value of $b,$ we substitute $t=3$ into $x=5 t + 3.$ This gives

$$
b=5 (3) + 3=(3)+(15)=18.
$$

- To find the value of $c,$ we substitute $t=1$ into $y=3 t - 2.$ This gives

$$
c=3 (1) - 2=(-2)+(3)=1.
$$

Finally, we have

$$
a-b-c=(-2)-(18)-(1)=-21.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the curve with parametric equations

$$
x=5 t - 1,\,y=5 t + 3,\,-1\le t\le 4.
$$

Fill in the blanks in the following table of values:

| **$t$** | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $a$ | $-1$ | $4$ | $9$ | $b$ | $19$ |
| $y$ | $-2$ | $3$ | $c$ | $13$ | $18$ | $23$ |

Find the value of $a-b-c.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
- To find the value of $a,$ we substitute $t=-1$ into $x=5 t - 1.$ This gives

$$
a=5 (-1) - 1=(-1)+(-5)=-6.
$$

- To find the value of $b,$ we substitute $t=3$ into $x=5 t - 1.$ This gives

$$
b=5 (3) - 1=(-1)+(15)=14.
$$

- To find the value of $c,$ we substitute $t=1$ into $y=5 t + 3.$ This gives

$$
c=5 (1) + 3=(3)+(5)=8.
$$

Finally, we have

$$
a-b-c=(-6)-(14)-(8)=-28.
$$

| $x$ | $a$ | $0$ | $-3$ | $-6$ | $b$ | $-12$ |
| $y$ | $-8$ | $-3$ | $c$ | $7$ | $12$ | $17$ |

Find the value of $a-b-c.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
- To find the value of $a,$ we substitute $t=-1$ into $x=- 3 t.$ This gives

$$
a=- 3 (-1)=(3)=3.
$$

- To find the value of $b,$ we substitute $t=3$ into $x=- 3 t.$ This gives

$$
b=- 3 (3)=(-9)=-9.
$$

- To find the value of $c,$ we substitute $t=1$ into $y=5 t - 3.$ This gives

$$
c=5 (1) - 3=(-3)+(5)=2.
$$

Finally, we have

$$
a-b-c=(3)-(-9)-(2)=10.
$$
